verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party Brave SDK library. The only SDK path documented is that the Answers endpoint works with the OpenAI SDK, which covers a single service through a third-party client. The official MCP server, n8n node and agent skills are integrations, not general-purpose SDKs, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404, so no published spec exists to generate clients from. Missing for 10: first-party Brave SDKs in common languages, SDK coverage of web/news/image/video/LLM Context endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of SDK use.
